sync.key.preview: the key is sent once to conductor-sync, stored encrypted and never shown again
sync.key.title: Set the Google service account key

sync.test.heading: Test the connection
sync.test.hint: Connects to AD with the sync account and to Google with the stored key (read-only), using the settings of this draft.
files.intro: Share folders on the network from domain-member file servers. Each server runs the conductor-files agent; access is granted to AD groups and applied as share and folder permissions. Domain controllers never host file shares.
files.disabled.title: The File servers section is not enabled
files.disabled.text: Set [files] enabled = true in conductor.toml and restart conductor; then enroll each file server with a code made on it (conductor-files enroll-code).
files.empty.title: No file server yet
files.empty.text: Install conductor-files on a domain-member file server, run conductor-files enroll-code there and add the server here.
files.key.heading: Conductor's key
files.key.hint: File servers trust this key only (they pin it at enrollment). On a server, conductor-files trust list shows the same value.
files.key.name: Name
files.plan.share_acl_hint: Checked when someone connects to the share (sharesec).
files.plan.nt_acl_hint: On {0}; new files and folders inside inherit them.
files.new.title: Add a file server
files.new.step1: Join the server to the domain and install conductor-files (see its install guide).
files.new.step2: On the server, as root, make a one-time code:
files.new.step3: Enter the server's address and the code below, then confirm with your second factor.
files.new.address_hint: Host name or IP address; port 7443 unless given (host:port).
files.new.code_hint: cfe1.… as printed by conductor-files enroll-code (valid 1 hour, single use).
files.new.key_hint: The server will pin conductor's key:
files.new.err.address: Enter a host name or IP address (optionally :port).
files.new.err.code: That is not an enrollment code (cfe1.<token>.<key>).
files.new.err.exists: This address is already enrolled as {0}.
files.new.err.same_key: A server with this key is already enrolled ({0}).
files.new.confirm_summary: conductor connects to {0}, checks the server's key against the code and hands over its own key.
files.check.member_not_dc: Domain member, not a domain controller
files.check.registry_shares: Shares read from the registry (include = registry)
files.check.roots: Share roots owned by root, not writable by others
files.check.samba_tools: Samba programs installed (net, sharesec, samba-tool, smbcontrol, wbinfo)
files.remove.hint: Conductor forgets the server and its key; the server drops conductor's key. Shares on the server stay as they are.
files.remove.title: Remove file server {0}
files.remove.summary: Conductor will no longer manage this server. Its shares are not changed.
files.remove.done_unreachable: File server {0} removed here, but it could not be reached: on the server run conductor-files trust remove {1}.
files.share.name: Share name
files.share.title: Share {0}
files.share.unmanaged: This share was not created by Samba Conductor: it is shown read-only and never changed here.
files.share.remove_summary: {0} stops being shared on {1}. The folder and its files are kept.
files.share.not_managed: Only shares created by Samba Conductor can be edited.
files.opt.abe_hint: access-based enumeration: the share and the files someone cannot read are not shown to them
files.opt.recycle_hint: deleted files go to .recycle/<user> in the share instead of disappearing
files.opt.shadow_hint: snapshots of the file system appear as previous versions in Windows
files.opt.shadow_unavailable: not available: this server has no snapshot profile ([shadow_copies] in agent.toml)
files.sessions.title: Sessions on {0}
files.wizard.name_hint: Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore; a trailing $ hides it from the network list.
files.wizard.name_fixed: A share's name cannot change; create a new share instead.
files.wizard.folder_hint: Pick a folder below the server's share roots, or create a new one here. Symbolic links are never followed.
files.wizard.not_usable: cannot be shared from here (its parent is writable by others)
files.wizard.truncated: Only the first 1,000 folders are listed.
files.wizard.newdir: Or create a new folder in {0}
files.wizard.newdir_hint: Created when you apply, owned by root, then given the permissions below.
files.wizard.access_hint: AD groups, each with read, modify (read, write, delete) or full control. Applied to the share and to the folder; new content inherits them.
files.wizard.no_access: No group yet: add at least one.
files.wizard.fixed_admins: SYSTEM, Administrators and Domain Admins always have full control.
files.wizard.review_hint: The server shows exactly what it will do (configuration, permissions, commands); nothing changes until you confirm with your second factor.
files.wizard.expired: That draft is no longer open; start again.
files.wizard.err.name: Use letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (up to 63, an optional trailing $); some names are reserved.
files.wizard.err.comment: The description may not contain %, \, quotes or line breaks.
files.wizard.err.newdir_edit: A new folder can only be created with a new share.
files.wizard.err.folder_name: That folder name is not allowed (no /, %, \, quotes, control characters, a leading - or surrounding spaces).
files.wizard.err.folder: Choose a folder or enter a new folder name.
files.wizard.err.no_access: Give at least one group access.
files.plan.no_change: Nothing to change: the share already looks like this.

files.warn.folder_kept: The folder {0} and its files are kept, with their permissions.
files.err.disabled: The File servers section is not enabled.

files.err.unreachable: The file server could not be reached.

files.err.failed: The file server could not do it.

files.err.not_found: Not found on the file server:

files.err.forbidden: The file server does not allow it:

files.plan.preview_hint: This is what the file server runs, with your account recorded in its audit log and in conductor's. The apply is refused if anything changed since this plan.
files.reauth: Changes to file servers need your password and a code from your authenticator.
sync.config.connection_hint: How conductor-sync reaches AD and Google, the ownership marker, the alert webhook and the secrets. Edited on the Connection page.
sync.conn.title: Connection settings
sync.conn.source_stored: In force: settings version {0} (edited here or imported). The configuration file is the bootstrap and the export format.
sync.conn.source_file: In force: the configuration file {0} (never edited here). Saving here stores a version that takes precedence over the file.
sync.conn.draft: Unsaved changes (a draft in this session). Test the connection, then review and save.
sync.conn.draft_nochange: The draft does not change any setting.
sync.conn.draft_password: A new bind password was entered with this draft (not shown). It is saved with the draft, after a successful test.
sync.conn.ad_hint: conductor-sync reads AD with this account over LDAPS, with the domain CA pinned. A change is saved only after conductor-sync signs in with it.
sync.conn.dcs_hint: One per line (host name or IP). Empty: DNS SRV discovery.
sync.conn.dns_hint: IP addresses (with an optional port) that resolve the domain. Empty: the host resolver.
sync.conn.bind_user_hint: An unprivileged account (Domain Users is enough). Never an administrator.
sync.conn.new_password: New bind password (only with a new bind account)
sync.conn.new_password_hint: Write only: never shown again. To change only the password, use Replace in Secrets below.
sync.conn.drop_password: Forget the password entered with this draft
sync.conn.ca_pem_hint: Paste the certificates, or upload a file below. Only certificates are accepted.
sync.conn.ca_use_file: Use the host's CA file {0} instead
sync.conn.rps_hint: Pace of the Directory API calls (default 5).
sync.conn.webhook_url_hint: HTTPS (or HTTP to a loopback relay). Empty: alerts go to the journal only. The HMAC secret is under Secrets.
sync.conn.test_hint: Tests this draft: a sign-in to AD and a read of the admin subject on Google with the stored key. Saving a change to AD or Google needs a successful test of exactly these values.
sync.conn.test_outdated: The draft changed after this test: test it again before saving.
sync.conn.test_needed: These changes need a successful connection test before they can be saved.
sync.conn.err_ca: This is not a CA certificate file (PEM, certificates only, at most 64 KiB).
sync.conn.err_password: The bind password must be one line of at most 1024 bytes.
sync.conn.err_untested: Test the connection with these values before saving.
sync.conn.err_test_failed: The connection test failed: fix the values and test again.
sync.conn.preview_note: secrets are never shown; conductor-sync signs in to AD again before it stores an AD change
sync.conn.ad_warning: These settings decide where conductor-sync connects and sends the bind account's credentials. Check the DCs and the CA.
sync.conn.save_summary: {0} setting(s) change. A new settings version is stored; the previous one can be restored from the history.
sync.secret.heading: Secrets
sync.secret.hint: Write only: conductor-sync stores them encrypted and never returns them. Only whether each one is configured, and who changed it when, is shown.
sync.secret.col.name: Secret
sync.secret.preview: the value is sent once to conductor-sync, stored encrypted and never shown again
sync.secret.replace_summary: The new {0} replaces the current one. It is never shown again.
sync.secret.fallback_file: the credential file {0} named in the configuration is used again
sync.secret.fallback_none: no credential file is named in the configuration
sync.secret.remove_warning.ad_bind_passw: Without a bind password (stored or in a credential file) conductor-sync cannot read AD: plans and scheduled runs fail.
sync.secret.remove_warning.google_servic: Without a service account key (stored or in a credential file) conductor-sync cannot reach Google: plans and scheduled runs fail.
sync.secret.remove_warning.alert_webhook: Without a secret, alerts posted to the webhook are no longer signed.
sync.secret.err_value.ad_bind_password: The bind password must be one line of at most 1024 bytes.
sync.secret.err_value.alert_webhook_secr: The webhook secret: 16 to 1024 printable characters, no spaces.
sync.secret.err_ad_test: AD refused this password (nothing was saved):
sync.secret.err_not_stored: Nothing is stored for this secret (it comes from a credential file, or is not configured).
sync.marker.heading: Ownership marker
sync.marker.explain: Every Google account the sync creates or adopts carries this marker. Changing it orphans the accounts marked with the current value: the sync no longer recognizes them as its own (they are not changed, suspended or relinked by marker). Change it only for a new sync instance or tenant, and only on purpose.
sync.marker.err_confirm: The typed confirmation does not match. Type exactly: {0}
sync.marker.err_use_form: The ownership marker is changed with its own form (typed confirmation).
sync.marker.title: Change the ownership marker
sync.marker.warning: Accounts marked {0} are orphaned: the sync stops treating them as its own. This is not undone by changing the marker back unless no run happened in between.
sync.rollback.heading: Roll back the settings
sync.rollback.hint: Its settings are stored as a new version, after the current version {0}. Nothing is applied to Google until a plan is reviewed and applied.
sync.rollback.secrets_note: Secrets are not versioned: the bind password, the service account key and the webhook secret stay as they are.
sync.rollback.nochange: This version has the same settings as the current one.
sync.rollback.type_hint: This rollback changes the ownership marker. Type exactly: {0}
sync.rollback.title: Roll back to version {0}
sync.rollback.summary: {0} setting(s) change back. A new version is stored.
sync.rollback.done: Settings of version {0} restored as a new version.
